#+TITLE: Footnote export
#+AUTHOR: Test Author

The definitions live under the "Footnotes" heading at the end, which
Org treats as `org-footnote-section' and drops from the export, so it
should not appear in the expected output.

* Named, anonymous, and repeated
A named footnote[fn:one], an anonymous one[fn::inline text, defined in
place], and a second reference to the first[fn:one] — the repeat reuses
the label instead of duplicating the definition.

* A second named footnote
Distinct labels get distinct definitions[fn:two].

* Markup inside a definition
Definitions are transcoded like any other content[fn:markup].

* References from other constructs
- a list item with a footnote[fn:inlist]
- a plain item

| a table cell[fn:intable] | second |

* Footnotes

[fn:one] The first definition.

[fn:two] The second definition.

[fn:markup] Contains *bold*, /italic/, and a [[https://typst.app][link]].

[fn:inlist] Referenced from inside a list.

[fn:intable] Referenced from inside a table.
